svg.title: Pattern-v2 hit rate and speedup by request
svg.desc: Three-panel comparison for requests 1 through 100. The first panel is a four-row hit-rate heatmap, the second compares paired demand-only and Pattern-v2 drained wall time, and the third shows conservative speedup relative to a 1.0x demand-only baseline. Gray cells represent unavailable denominators rather than misses.
svg.text: Pattern-v2 hit rate and speedup by request
100 traces | 98 timed, 61 hit-evaluable | 8x AB/BA isolated C=1 | risk-limited | 5 ms service, 2.5 ms lead
B Paired drained tool-path wall time
Request number (one source trace per request)
Top-k: whole-session OOF exact-URL recall. Runtime: overlap-producing reuse only. Gray: N/A, not a miss.
Synthetic proxy (replay start through broker cleanup), not production E2E; Pattern-v2 includes charged predictor/selection overhead.
